key_findings.finding: Steady-state pooled Pearson r for FUR-Z3-TEMP→FUR-YIELD = 0.8987, →FUR-OUT-TEMP = 0.7419 (best lag +4 steps = +40 min, consistent with residence-time transport delay), →PROF-MEAN = 0.8584 (lag 0). Detrending attenuation ≈0 → not a linear-trend artifact.

All strong correlations are level-shift dominated: e.g. Z3→YIELD r=0.8987 vs Spearman ρ=0.5098 (|r|-|ρ| gap 0.389); 50 pairs carry pair-level trend-confounded/attenuation flags while the battery aggregate reports 0 trend-confounded — the correlation mass sits in between-regime level changes (maintenance window −4.93 °C on Z3).

Change-point evidence on DCS series: FUR-OUT-TEMP segments 549.90 °C (rows 0-721) → 546.36 °C (722-933, dip) → 549.96 °C (934+); FUR-YIELD 12 change points, degradation window mean 98.07% vs 99.30% before.
FUR-SPEED–FUR-OUT-TEMP expected negative correlation NOT detectable: r=-0.0125, p=0.645 (speed range 11.826–12.157 ≈ ±1.4% — insufficient variance/power).
8 anomaly intervals detected (dp_toolkit); the dominant signature is step/plateau (see change-points), not isolated point anomalies.
physics_check.py: THERMAL_COUPLING_NOT_DETECTED (dimensionless deviation vs temperature r=-0.2365) and ARRHENIUS_PLAUSIBLE (predicted rate ratio 32.05) — no physics-impossible configuration found.

limitations: Row-level p-values for HX-involving pairs are optimistic (backward-merged step-constant blocks, effective n = snapshots).
LAB-HRC not joined to the anchor table → no hardness-side validation possible (evidence gap).
FUR-SPEED / FUR-PRES units undeclared → only relative drift usable.
IMG gray statistics uncalibrated → only relative interpretation; no dark-frame data to separate camera/lighting drift from process-driven radiance change.

time_lag_compensator.mjs matched 0 pairs (it could not resolve the step interval for the 'process_grid' axis) → lag evidence comes from the stats-lag CCF (1 step = 600 s, per 02_processed/time_alignment.json median_interval_s=600).

expert_custom_analysis.why_needed: The fixed battery (i) pools across regimes so it cannot separate level shift from tracking — the decisive question here (within-segment correlations: Z3~YIELD = 0.027 pre / 0.855 maintenance / 0.739 restored); (ii) reports undefined correlations (0.0) for constant columns; (iii) cannot evaluate registration-drift confounder (SHIFT-EST constant) or snapshot-level dedup; (iv) produced a false 2D-field chart set that had to be pruned.
